fusions.name: Wind to Spare
fusions.desc: A running kick on a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ridden Ragged
fusions.desc: Rides through a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, which deals 26 damage, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, to everything in it and leaves each one [Fatigued] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cooling Walk
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Broken to Saddle
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. You can ride it.
